verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort, matching the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly grouped regions are offset by small text, changing flow directions, and several long routes that require close tracing.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and label chips generally have generous clearance, but the very large canvas makes their text relatively small at arm's length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Four color-coded, numbered horizontal regions establish the operational stages and ownership immediately.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Most local arrows are clean and labeled, but the orange handoff route and especially the dashed purple feedback loop make long perimeter detours, while alternating leftward, rightward, and vertical flows slow tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: The board clearly decomposes intake, self-service, handoff, and improvement, though the main path and recovery branches must be reconstructed across wide gaps and direction changes.
